picks.title: H1 secures $40M from CVS, proving SaaS startups can still attract investment
picks.why_it_matters: Strategic corporate investment from CVS validates that vertical SaaS with proprietary data moats can still command funding even as AI threatens commodity workflow tools—a thesis early-stage investors should note when evaluating defensibility.

picks.title: Why Paris may be the most important AI city outside Silicon Valley
picks.why_it_matters: Signals a maturing European founder ecosystem willing to scale locally, opening new sourcing opportunities for VCs looking beyond the Bay Area for AI talent at potentially better valuations.

picks.title: Glean's top line crosses $300M as AI budget-cutting becomes its major selling point
picks.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that enterprise AI startups can win against Big Tech incumbents by focusing on cost reduction ROI—a go-to-market positioning early-stage founders should consider as enterprises shift from AI experimentation to deployment.
